    f.userregistry AS user_id,
    f.nicklabel AS nickname,
    COUNT(*) AS number_of_idols,
    STRING_AGG(v.nametag, ', ' ORDER BY v.nametag) AS idol_names,
    ROUND(AVG(e.engrate)::numeric, 2) AS avg_engagement_rate
FROM fans f
JOIN interactions i ON i.interactfanpivot = f.userregistry
JOIN engagement e ON e.engageactivitypivot = i.activityreg
JOIN virtualidols v ON v.entityreg = i.interactidolpivot
GROUP BY f.userregistry, f.nicklabel
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY number_of_idols DESC, avg_engagement_rate DESC;
